description: AS 58453 leaked routes from its peer AS 41095 to its provider AS 59257. The abnormal triplet '41095 58453 59257' exhibits a peer-to-peer (rel=0) followed by customer-to-provider (rel=-1) pattern, violating valley-free routing. The origin AS 138423 is the legitimate owner of prefix 121.91.63.0/24. During the incident, a new path '41095 58453 59257 138423' emerged, while pre-incident paths primarily used either '38193 138423' (via AS 174, 6939, etc.) or '58453 59257 138423' (via other peers).
